name: horse-ai-conversations
description: AI conversation ownership and persistence for Horse: binds horse-session principals to horse-ai streams with ownership-checked cancellation, multiple conversations per user, (tenant_id, principal_id, conversation_id) tuple as logical key, pluggable IAIConversationStore (in-memory default; durable adapters ship as siblings). Reuses horse-session's TAuthAuditEvent + IAuthAuditSink unchanged.
